common.footer: EcoSort AI · Built with Flask & a vision-language model

detect.title: Waste Detector
detect.subtitle: Multi-object detection + classification, running live on your machine.
detect.sensitivity_hint: High finds more items but can make mistakes. Low is stricter and more accurate.
detect.empty_state_webcam: Start the camera or upload a photo to see detections here.
detect.empty_state_upload: No waste items detected yet. Point the camera at an object.

biodegradable.label: Biodegradable
biodegradable.tip: Compostable organic waste. Breaks down naturally.

recyclable.label: Recyclable (Dry Waste)
recyclable.tip: Clean paper, plastic, glass or metal that can be reprocessed.

non_recyclable.label: Non-Recyclable (Reject Waste)
non_recyclable.tip: Mixed-material or soiled waste that cannot be recycled or composted.

e_waste.label: E-Waste
e_waste.tip: Electronic/electrical items. Contains recoverable metals and toxic components.

hazardous.label: Hazardous Waste
hazardous.tip: Chemically reactive, toxic or flammable waste needing special handling.

ignore.label: Not Waste
ignore.tip: Not a waste item. This project focuses on segregating discarded objects, so people, animals, vehicles and furniture are ignored.
